paraphrase: Under the supposition that no Necessary Being is possible, the source classifies every causal-concrete thing as contingent and obtains ordinary concrete-to-contingent entailment. It applies the selected ordinary-to-nontrivial transfer at P=contingency to infer NT(concrete-and-necessary,contingent), contradicts the negative relation-instance report, rejects the supposition at7 and concludes possible Necessary Being at8. The outer hypothesis persists through1–6; hypothetical classifications/NT entailments are not exported. This attributes conditional reasoning, not source soundness, independent possibility, actual existence or a rigid necessary individual.
